name: ClassyText
description: ClassyText is a demo for zero-shot text classification using ModernBERT-large from Hugging Face.

paragraphs: Zero-shot classification is a transfer learning method that uses a pre-trained language model to predict a class not seen during training. This project uses a new promising zero-shot text classification model ModernBERT-large-zeroshot-v2.0 from the Hugging Face model hub to classify text into different classes. Models in this series are designed for efficient zero-shot classification with the Hugging Face pipeline. These models can classify without training data and run on both GPUs and CPUs.
